calculation.description: The negative of a volatility-scaled 20-day trend, amplified when medium-term volatility exceeds recent volatility. The sign reversal captures the empirically validated tendency for compressed, risk-adjusted trends to mean-revert over the 10-trading-day portfolio horizon. All inputs are lagged one completed bar.

validation.regime_notes: Validated over multiple regimes from 2020 through 2028 using the full 15-asset benchmark universe. IC is negative for the un-oriented trend expression; the persisted factor reverses its sign based on the pre-specified empirical orientation. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.

admission_gate.note: The 10-day horizon matches the rebalance cadence; daily paper metrics are also reported.

provenance.source_universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; observation-only macro symbols excluded
provenance.future_data_policy: Signal uses only close data through t-1; forward returns are used solely for validation.
